---
title: "P: Antiparasitic products, insecticides and repellents"
description: "ATC group P for modellers: life cycle stages as separate targets, parasitaemia decline as the endpoint, and wide patient-driven variability."
date: "2026-02-08"
---

Drugs directed at eukaryotic parasites: protozoa, helminths and ectoparasites.
Their targets resemble host cells far more closely than a bacterium does, so selective targets are harder to find [@chan2026anthelmintic; @horn2014antiparasitic], though the therapeutic window varies sharply across the group rather than being uniformly narrow.

A fourth-century recipe by Ge Hong said to wring qinghao out in cold water, so Tu Youyou switched to low-temperature ether extraction.
Her extract 191, dated 4 October 1971, gave complete inhibition of rodent malaria, and artemisinin won her a share of the 2015 Nobel Prize [@suDiscoveryArtemisininNobel2015].

| Level 2 code | Description | In plain terms | Current standard |
| ---: | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| [P01](p01_antiprotozoals/) | Antiprotozoals | kill single-celled parasites: malaria, amoebiasis, giardiasis | Artemether/lumefantrine (P01BF01) / metronidazole (P01AB01) |
| P02 | Anthelmintics | deworming drugs against parasitic worms | Albendazole (P02CA03) / praziquantel (P02BA01) |
| P03 | Ectoparasiticides, incl. scabicides, insecticides and repellents | kill skin parasites: scabies mites, lice; repellents | Permethrin (P03AC04) / diethyltoluamide, i.e. DEET (P03BX01) |

## Modelling notes

**Life cycle stages are separate targets.**
A drug active against one stage may be inactive against the next [@delves2012lifecycle; @white2014malaria], so the model must declare which stage the effect attaches to.
Synchronised replication, sequestration of mature forms and dormant liver forms all produce behaviour a direct-effect model on total burden will not reproduce [@saralamba2011intrahost; @hodelIncorporatingStageSpecificDrug2016].

**Endpoint.**
Parasitaemia decline for the blood-dwelling protozoa [@krausePharmacokineticPharmacodynamicModelling2016], estimated as a clearance slope from the whole profile rather than a single visit [@fleggStandardizingMeasurementParasite2011; @stepniewskaVivoParasitologicalMeasures2010].
For helminths it is the faecal egg count, reported as cure rate and egg reduction rate [@moserOneMeanRule2020; @brusseePopulationPharmacokineticsExposure2021].

**Variability is wide, and mostly about the patient.**
Endemic populations skew [paediatric](/docs/concepts/pediatrics/), so weight-band dosing [@waalewijn2025weightbands; @banda2025infants] and allometric scaling with maturation [@germovsek2017scaling] are the starting point.
For the lipophilic agents, fat-dependent absorption is the first thing to characterise: a normal meal roughly doubles lumefantrine bioavailability [@ezzet2000LumefantrinePkpd; @jain2017LumefantrineBioavailability].
